I am undergraduate student majoring in Computer Science with a minor in Mathematics. My research interests lie in safety-critical navigation for robots and autonomous systems. I am particularly interested in developing novel algorithms spanning perception, planning, and control that enable autonomous systems to navigate safely in complex, uncertain, and previously unseen environments.
